name: @openrig/studio-fleet
description: Reads which LLM account each box is signed in as, how much of its limit is spent, and when a parked account frees up again.
_note: NOTHING HERE READS, STORES OR TRANSPORTS A TOKEN. Usage can only be read by authenticating as the account, so the naive central dashboard ends up holding one credential per account — a monitoring feature with the blast radius of a credential store. This pulls the READING instead: the controller runs the probe ON each box, against the token that box already holds. If a future change needs a token here, that is a design change and not an implementation detail.
